author: ElfLardLicker
body:
Hey guys, umm I decided to make a new map. I made a Huge city one but when I copied and pasted it (because I only made one side) It kept failing so I made a new one and now I have world edit so it will be a lot easier to make changes. Um it's about 80% done I added some details and a middle. I didnt put half slabs as the sides becasue it looked really bad.



% done so yeah. I want to add a design to the flat part one each teams base. So tell me what that shoud look like and Please tell me how to update a post.
anything else too. :).
